event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target, to go over your symptoms and the hormonal and non-hormonal options and what suits your history. Your reported hot flashes, night sweats and irregular periods fit the menopausal transition, but options depend on your medical background. If you develop heavy or unusual vaginal bleeding, unexplained weight loss, fever, or a fast or irregular heartbeat, seek clinical assessment promptly rather than waiting for a reply.
